output.reason: Evidence shows that (1) the RBI “Reserve Bank of India (Pre-payment Charges on Loans) Directions, 2025” was withdrawn/repealed effective 2025-11-28 and is stated to be no longer in force as of 2026-11-23; and (2) the earlier “Levy of Foreclosure Charges/Pre-payment Penalty on Floating Rate Term Loans (2014)” was withdrawn/repealed effective 2026-01-01 and is stated to be no longer in force as of 2026-11-23.
